title: Weak separation and finite-trace coding: independence of infinite fin-intersecting MAD families
description: We prove that, under s < ap, an almost disjoint family is fin-intersecting exactly when its size is less than s. A uniform finite-trace coding lemma converts countably many weak intersection tests into disjoint finite blocks, and complementary splitting labels exclude every sufficiently large candidate. With published cardinal comparisons and the Banakh-Machura-Zdomskyy consistency model, this yields relative independence over ZFC of the existence of an infinite fin-intersecting MAD family. The paper includes the CH positive construction, a hyperspace consequence, and a Cohen-model comparison. The companion Lean 4 development proves ap <= b <= a, the exact cutoff and nonexistence under s < ap alone, and the full CH construction of an infinite FI MAD family of size aleph_1. YesMetaZFC supplies a generic proof-theoretic schema. The forcing constructions, relative consistency of CH, first-order semantic bridge, stronger published positive theorem, and full independence theorem are not formalized. Prepared with generative AI assistance including GPT-6 Astra; no independent expert review is claimed.
